title: Y-12/Oak Ridge legacy program studying the skin of two recovered saucers

tellings.quote: he has stated he has worked under the Y12 complex which houses Oak Ridge on a UFO legacy program that studies the skin of two recovered uh non-human saucer craft.

plain: A man says he worked under the Y-12 complex at Oak Ridge, Tennessee, a US government nuclear site, on a long-running secret UFO program that studies the outer skin of two recovered saucer-shaped craft of non-human origin. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes this on to Michels from what the man has stated, and links it to the private research contractors MITRE and Battelle, which do government work. If true, it would mean the US holds and studies non-human craft.
